data.description:
## What
Add ADR-002 to .claude/design-notes.md documenting the architectural decisions behind recipe integration into /dso:implementation-plan and /dso:sprint.

## Why
The existing ADR-001 covers the execution engine. The planning/sprint integration introduces new design decisions that future agents and engineers need to understand.

## Acceptance Criteria
- .claude/design-notes.md gains a new '## ADR-002: Recipe Integration into Implementation Planning and Sprint Execution' section with:
  - Status: Accepted
  - Context: why recipe tasks need to be planned (deterministic transforms should bypass LLM variance) and executed differently (token savings, consistent output)
  - Decision:
    - consult-recipe-registry.sh: called during Step 1 Contextual Discovery in implementation-plan; outputs recipe capabilities used to classify tasks
    - recipe: task type: assigned when a task's transform matches a recipe capability; task spec must include recipe_name, recipe_params, intent (from capability_description)
    - Pre-flight (check-recipe-engines.sh): runs in Phase C Step 1 before any tasks execute; populates MISSING_ENGINES_LIST; does NOT block sprint
    - Cleanup phase (detect-cleanup-recipes.sh + recipe-executor.sh): runs in Phase F after sub-agents return and before Step 13 review; detects applicable scope:single-file cleanup recipes; skips if no applicable recipes
    - LLM fallback (translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh): converts recipe spec to natural-language task when engine in MISSING_ENGINES_LIST; dispatches as GREEN sub-agent task; records RECIPE_FALLBACK ticket comment
  - Consequences: recipe tasks do not consume sub-agent tokens; missing-engine fallback means 100% plan coverage regardless of engine availability; cleanup phase may conflict with intentional import deviations (log + skip on conflict)
- Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md formatting conventions

## File Impact
- MODIFY: .claude/design-notes.md

## Testing Mode
GREEN — doc-only update; no executable behavior

## Dependencies
None (can run in parallel with Task 1)
data.title: GREEN: Add ADR-002 to design-notes.md documenting recipe planning and sprint integration decisions
